reading_task: Compare the five treatment means, sample SD and all three biological replicates within each separately scaled author-supplied outcome.
organization: Three separately exported single-outcome subpanels; repeated treatment order, data geometry and mark roles.
dimension_authorization: The user requested a major overhaul; a new case-specific physical adoption was explicitly proposed and recorded. Frozen prior v0.4.3 evidence is not edited.

visual_roles.category_identity: x position and labels, repeated across outcomes
visual_roles.outcome_identity: explicit y-axis quantity label and original-percent bounds, not a three-color assignment

source_analogues.evidence_status: Measured task critique supplied by parent; not independently measured here
source_analogues.use: Category/series count and reading task guide case-specific proportions; these differing ratios are not universal journal targets.

card_mechanism_inspected: replicate-neutral-compact actual good and failure images: transfer neutral role hierarchy, not its 60×62mm geometry.

basis: Open neutral means remain definite while dark observations and SD carry measured variation.
A single outcome in each subpanel is already decoded by the y-axis; different outcome hues would add lookup without serving this within-outcome task.
Subdued single-hue filled means are valid but add unnecessary area mass for these five sparse triplicate groups.
Landscape regions and .45-pitch boundaries correct the tall thin-column structure in both candidates.

scientific_locks: every original source text and source-cell identity
no normalization, cross-condition pairing or new hypothesis test
baseline_comparison_limit: Previous and new physical dimensions differ by explicit adoption, so only qualitative design-change observations are claimed; matched-dimension comparative preference is not checked. Neutral-open versus slate-fill candidates share the same new dimensions.
